{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for any sentinel values in biomarker_baseline or biomarker_final
# The data dictionary says -999.0 is a sentinel for missing
sentinel_check = trial_df[['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].isin([-999.0]).any().any()

# Check if any site has an unusual distribution of severity
severity_by_site = trial_df.groupby(['site', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

print("Sentinel value check (-999.0): ", sentinel_check)
print("\nSeverity distribution by site:\n", severity_by_site)"}
